title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
summary: A gifted young man recounts his rise from a troubled childhood to becoming a legendary figure, blending magic, music, and mystery.

title: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: In a world blanketed by ash under a tyrannical Lord Ruler, a young thief with rare powers joins a crew plotting the ultimate heist: overthrowing an empire.

title: The Blade Itself
author: Joe Abercrombie
summary: A gritty tale following a scarred torturer, a vain swordsman, and a savage barbarian as their paths converge amid political intrigue and looming war.

title: The Will of the Many
author: James Islington
summary: In an empire built on a system where the strong can drain the will of the weak, a hidden heir infiltrates an elite academy to uncover long-buried secrets.
